profile_text.body:
Appian Corp is a public company headquartered in McLean, Virginia, traded under the ticker APPN. On its own site the company describes itself as providing AI automation for the most important business processes at the world's largest organizations, and says its platform lets customers orchestrate AI agents, systems, and people from a unified platform. Appian states that it has been automating processes for more than 25 years.

The site presents the Appian platform around process automation, giving AI reliability and control, and modernizing legacy applications with AI. It describes low-code building of AI-powered apps with embedded AI agents that extract data, act autonomously, and generate code from natural language prompts. Named use cases include accounts payable and receivable, invoice processing and reconciliation, sourcing and supplier management, audit and compliance workflows, case management, procure-to-pay, onboarding, order management, and contract review. Appian says onboarding can be cut by up to 50%. The company states it was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies (BOAT), and it points to an AI Value Study produced with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.

Company records list Appian as a for-profit public company with SEC CIK 0001441683. Its litigation exposure is recorded in Virginia, with 133 cases.
